name: Naomi Griffin
researchKeywords: criminal justice and health, stigma and marginalisation, vulnerable populations, children and young people
bio: Naomi Griffin is a Research Associate in Newcastle University's Population Health Sciences Institute. Her work examines health inequalities and the effects of stigma and marginalisation on vulnerable and multiply disadvantaged populations.
researchFocus: Naomi studies inequalities within and arising from engagement with the criminal justice system. Her work includes the Divided Households project on the health and wellbeing of children and young people with a family member in prison, and research on coordination between health and justice systems during resettlement after a custodial sentence.
